entities.summary: Flavio Pace is an Italian Roman Catholic prelate who has served as Secretary of the Dicastery for Promoting Christian Unity of the Roman Curia since February 2024. He previously served as Under-Secretary of the Dicastery for the Eastern Churches from 2020 to 2024. He holds the personal title of titular archbishop of Dolia.
